data.name: Project Corner
data.detailed_description:
Prop Hunt in the World of Project Corner

Are you ready to test your intuition, cunning, and knowledge of every single corner in the Project Corner game? Welcome to the official "Prop Hunt" mode - a dynamic, intense, and incredibly thrilling game where familiar locations turn into a massive arena for survival and deception!

In this game, players are divided into two teams with completely opposite goals. Will you manage to blend into the environment, or will you become the hunter from whose gaze no detail can escape?

Play on our dedicated servers with your friends or search public rooms to play with randoms.

The Game is Split into Two Teams:

Hunters

Your mission is to clear the location of fake objects. At the start of the round, you are frozen in place while the panicked targets frantically scramble for a hiding spot. As soon as the timer runs out, the real hunt begins!

  • Utilize Your Arsenal: You have access to unique abilities for each hunter: crowbar, grenades, and much more.

  • Trust Your Instincts: Notice any inconsistencies in the environment. Is that shadow falling the wrong way? Was that crate always sitting there? Strike without hesitation!

Props

You are the masters of disguise. Your goal is to survive until the end of the round at all costs.

  • Transformation: Become part of the environment. Turn into a cup on a table, a massive wardrobe in the corner of a room, or a regular cardboard box in a warehouse.

  • Movement is Life: Are the seekers getting too close? Use the "taunt/whistle" mechanic to mock them and earn extra points or make a sudden dash to another wing of the map while the hunter’s back is turned.

Unique Interactive Maps

New unique maps with every single season! You will have to hide in a wide variety of locations:

  • The Office Building: The 30th (top) floor and the rooftop, connected by two staircases - a non-stop chase between floors until someone makes a mistake. Features nearly 100 unique objects to transform into.

Game Mode Features

  • Hunter Abilities: Choose from different characters to hunt down the hidden props. Each hunter possesses 3 unique abilities: 2 regular skills with cooldowns, and 1 ultimate ability that is available once in a round.

  • Random Prop Shuffling: At the start of each round, props are assigned a random object to hide as. Once the round reaches its halfway point, every prop player's object is randomly swapped out for a new one.

Gather your friends, create a lobby, and prove who is the true master of disguise and who is the ultimate detective. The clock is ticking... Ready or not, here I come!

data.short_description: Tactical multiplayer hide-and-seek game. Turn into random environment objects to blend in or become a hunter to track down opponents. Suddenness, fun and betrayal!
data.supported_languages: English, Russian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Uzbek

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Target: 1080p / 60 FPS on Low settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 7 1700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Target: 1080p / 120 FPS on High settings.
